description: Prompt + previous agent message pairs for the context gate in examples/prompt_turn_eval.rs. search: true when the turn asks for work (new work, or approval/selection of work the agent proposed), so memories about that work can matter; false when nothing further is asked (thanks, praise, acknowledging a finished result, stop). Tags: paired (the same prompt appears with another previous message and the opposite label), refers_back (the prompt alone does not say what the work is), self_contained (the prompt names its own task), no_action. Hand-written; not drawn from real sessions.
